diseases.symptoms: Concentric rings (target board pattern) on older leaves, dark brown to black spots, yellow halo around spots, defoliation from bottom upwards.
diseases.causes: High humidity, warm temperatures (24-30°C), frequent rainfall or overhead sprinkler irrigation.
treatment: Foliar spray of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2-2.5 g/liter or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/liter.
For severe attack, spray Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/liter.
Remove and safely burn lower infected leaves.
organic_solution: Spray Neem oil (10,000 ppm) @ 3-5 ml/liter water with soap solution every 7 days.
Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide foliar application (5g/liter).
Mulching around the base to prevent soil splash onto foliage.

diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular pale green/brown lesions on leaf edges, white cottony mildew under the leaves in humid conditions, rapid browning and rot.
diseases.causes: Cool, moist weather (10-20°C) with persistent fog, high relative humidity (>90%).
treatment: Immediate spray of Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil MZ) @ 2.5 g/liter.
Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2-3 g/liter at first appearance.
Avoid any overhead irrigation immediately.
organic_solution: Bordeaux mixture (1%) preventive spray.
Copper hydroxide 77% WP @ 2 g/liter.
Ensure wide plant spacing and good air circulation.

diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions turning dark brown/black rapidly, foul smell in field, tuber rot with brownish-purple dry skin.
diseases.causes: Extended cold, cloudy days, drizzling rains and night condensation.
treatment: Spray Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/liter mixed with Mancozeb @ 2 g/liter.
Mandipropamid 23.4% SC @ 0.8 ml/liter for systemic protection.
Destroy infected haulms 10-12 days before tuber harvesting.
organic_solution: Spray fermented buttermilk (chaas) mixed with copper sulfate (heeng/asafoetida optional).
Trichoderma harzianum soil and foliar treatment.
Use certified disease-resistant seed tubers (e.g. Kufri Jyoti, Kufri Girdhari).

diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped or eye-shaped spots with grey or white center and brown/reddish margins on leaves; rotting of neck nodes (neck blast) causing blank panicles.
diseases.causes: Excessive nitrogen fertilizer, high humidity (>90%), dew, temperatures around 20-26°C.
treatment: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/liter water (highly effective).
Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/liter or Kasugamycin 3% SL @ 2 ml/liter.
Split nitrogen applications instead of heavy single doses.
organic_solution: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg seed.
Foliar spray of fresh cow urine solution (1:10 ratio) with neem extract.
Maintain balanced potash fertilization to strengthen plant cell walls.

diseases.disease_name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB - जीवाणु पत्ती झुलसा)
diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked stripes along leaf margins turning yellow to bleaching straw-white with wavy margins, milky bacterial ooze drops in morning.
diseases.causes: Strong winds, heavy rainfall, high temperatures (25-34°C), deep standing water.
treatment: Streptocycline (Streptomycin sulphate + Tetracycline) @ 1 g in 10 liters + Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 25 g.
Drain field water temporarily for 3-4 days.
Stop urea/nitrogen top dressing immediately until disease ceases.
organic_solution: Spray 2% Cow dung slurry supernatant.
Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens liquid formulation @ 5 ml/liter.
Crop rotation with legumes.

diseases.symptoms: Bright yellow pustules arranged in linear stripes/stripes parallel to leaf veins, yellow powder sticks to farmer clothes/fingers.
diseases.causes: Cool temperatures (10-15°C), high humidity, morning dews in northern plains.
treatment: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/liter (200 ml in 200 liters water per acre).
Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml/liter.
Single timely spray stops disease spread within 48 hours.
organic_solution: Grow rust-resistant cultivars like HD 2967, HD 3086, DBW 187, DBW 222.
Foliar spray of sour buttermilk (khatta chaas) with neem leaf extract.
Avoid late sowing of wheat.

diseases.disease_name: Northern Corn Leaf Blight (मक्के का पत्ती झुलसा)
diseases.symptoms: Long, elliptical, grayish-green or tan lesions (cigar-shaped) 2-15 cm in length on lower leaves progressing upwards.
diseases.causes: Moderate temperatures (18-27°C) accompanied by extended wet periods or heavy dew.
treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/liter or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/liter.
Apply at early tassel stage if lesions appear on third leaf below ear.
Deep ploughing to bury infested crop residue after harvest.
organic_solution: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum (10g/liter).
Neem cake soil incorporation @ 150 kg/acre.
Rotate corn with legumes or sunflower.

diseases.disease_name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (पत्ता मरोड़ रोग)
diseases.symptoms: Upward or downward curling of leaf margins, vein thickening, enation (cup-shaped leaf outgrowths), stunted plant height.
diseases.causes: High population of whitefly vectors in dry warm spells.
treatment: Control whitefly vector: Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/liter or Pyriproxyfen 10% + Bifenthrin 10% EC @ 2 ml/liter.
Flonicamid 50% WG @ 0.4 g/liter or Dinotefuran 20% SG @ 0.5 g/liter.
Eradicate weed hosts (Abutilon, Parthenium) on bunds.
organic_solution: Install 15-20 yellow sticky traps per acre.
Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Neem oil @ 5 ml/liter.
Intercrop with cowpea or maize as barrier crops.

diseases.disease_name: Healthy Plant Leaf (पौधा स्वस्थ और हरा-भरा है)
diseases.symptoms: Vibrant green leaves, uniform color, strong stems, no visible fungal spots, wilting or pest damage.
diseases.causes: Good nutrient management, optimal soil moisture and balanced sunlight.
treatment: No chemical fungicides or insecticides required.
Continue scheduled balanced irrigation.
Provide recommended N:P:K and micronutrient booster as per crop stage.
organic_solution: Apply Jeevamrutha or Panchagavya (3% spray) every 15 days to boost plant immunity.
Keep field clean of weeds and maintain light aeration.
